intro: Part 3: a recommendation. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A review usually combines a summary with an assessment. Look for which aspect the author evaluates and which reason is given; «selvom» can introduce a reservation before the conclusion.
